items.title: Cash Natural Gas Prices Mixed as Edouard Fades Over East Texas
items.summary: Physical natural gas prices mostly rose Wednesday as building heat supported demand from the Mississippi Valley into the Ohio Valley, while Gulf Coast hubs recovered some of Tuesday’s steep losses.

items.title: Natural Gas Futures Advance Ahead of Expected Lean Storage Build
items.summary: Natural gas futures pushed higher Wednesday as increasingly bullish September heat forecasts gave traders another reason to test the $3 mark, while renewed US-Iran fighting added a fresh jolt from overseas.

items.title: LNG Feedgas Demand Retreats Ahead of Sabine-Neches Waterway Reopening
items.summary: US LNG feedgas demand slipped to roughly 17.37 Bcf/d in Wednesday’s nominations, a decline of about 892 MMcf/d from Tuesday, according to NGI’s Entropic Analytics data.

items.title: Mexico’s Natural Gas Push Takes Aim at 75% Import Dependence
items.summary: President Claudia Sheinbaum in her state of the union address Tuesday said Mexico is targeting a reduction of US natural gas imports by bolstering infrastructure and the development of unconventional resources.

items.title: Seneca Expanding Appalachian Footprint as Natural Gas Demand Outlook Strengthens
items.summary: Seneca Resources is joining a growing list of Appalachian pure-plays working to bolt on acreage to strengthen inventories and expand development runways as natural gas demand is poised to strengthen.

items.title: September Heat Puts $3 Natural Gas Back in Sight
items.summary: Natural gas futures advanced Wednesday as hotter September forecasts and optimism over LNG exports pushed the prompt month toward $3/MMBtu, though strong production provided a counterweight.

items.title: Harvest Pushes Back Timeline for Reviving Alaska LNG Imports
items.summary: Harvest Midstream said it is now aiming for early 2029 to begin importing LNG at the long dormant Kenai terminal in Alaska.

items.title: EQT Exploring New 1 Bcf/d Appalachian Pipeline to Meet Growing Power Demand
items.summary: EQT has launched a non-binding open season for a 1 Bcf/d pipeline to help pair Appalachian natural gas with growing demand in the Midwest, Southeast and Gulf Coast markets.

items.title: Initial Trading Leans Bullish as Natural Gas Futures Forge Ahead
items.summary: Natural gas futures advanced early Wednesday as traders took stock of hefty supply, favorable but potentially fleeting weather, and robust LNG demand amid heightening tensions in the Middle East.

items.title: U.S. SPR Depletion Threatens Further Oil Price Volatility
items.summary: Crude oil prices are on their way up again, driven by the latest flare-up of hostilities in the Persian Gulf—but they are also up because U.S. crude inventories are down again, and the Strategic Petroleum Reserve is moving closer to critical levels.

items.title: Chevron Bets $7 Billion on Venezuela Oil Expansion
